voices.name: Bunty - Explainer
voices.description: Building a business, brand, or product and need a real voice? Go for this.

voices.name: Bunty - Fun Podcast Host
voices.description: Casual, confident, and genuinely fun to listen to. Bunty hosts like someone who's thought deeply about the topic but never makes you feel like you're in a lecture — his Hindi delivery has a natural ease that makes every episode feel like a conversation worth staying for. Built for Hindi podcasts, talk shows, opinion content, interview series, and audio platforms where the host's personality is the whole draw.

voices.name: Bunty - Loud & Expressive Massy Ads
voices.description: Energetic, bold, and built to be heard — Bunty brings a loud, expressive energy to mass market advertising that cuts through instantly and leaves a lasting impression. His high-voltage delivery makes every commercial feel like an event worth paying attention to. Built for FMCG ads, retail commercials, radio spots, and high-energy brand campaigns. Ideal for advertising agencies, D2C brands, and production houses building mass appeal campaigns that need a voice as big as the audience.

voices.name: Bunty – Smart Friendly Assistant
voices.description: Bunty brings a friendly, fun, and relatable tone that makes interactions feel natural and stress-free. His clear and confident hinglish delivery helps users stay informed without sounding robotic or overly formal. Designed for cases like task reminders, daily updates, scheduling help, basic queries, and conversational assistance. A strong fit for AI assistants, productivity tools, and voice-enabled apps and custom AI assistant experiences.

voices.name: Bunty – Friendly & Fun Customer Agent
voices.description: Bunty delivers an energetic, youthful, and friendly delivery that feels approachable and upbeat during e-commerce interactions. His tone keeps conversations light, helpful, and efficient. Ideal for order support, delivery updates, return and refund queries, onboarding calls, and customer assistance. Well-suited for e-commerce platforms, D2C brands, online marketplaces, and shopping apps that want customer support to feel fast, friendly, and relatable.

voices.name: Bunty - Funny Best Friend
voices.description: Bunty’s voice is full of charm, wit, and best-friend energy—ideal for funny reels, roast-style rants, relatable meme content, and banter-led storytelling. With a naturally desi tone and perfect comic timing, his voice feels like your everyday buddy pulling your leg, making it perfect for creators, meme pages, and short-form comedy content on social media platforms.

voices.name: Bunty - Warm and Clear
voices.description:
Bunty offers a warm, clear, and naturally paced voice ideal for audio descriptions in films and OTT content. His narration enhances accessibility by describing visual scenes, expressions, and transitions for blind and low-vision audiences — making content inclusive without compromising immersion.

Perfect for platforms where audio description helps expand reach and compliance with accessibility standards.

voices.name: Bunty - Energetic, Expressive and Fun
voices.description:
A vibrant AI voice crafted for content creators, influencers, and digital storytellers.

Bunty’s natural, expressive tone makes videos feel relatable and compelling, perfect for YouTube shorts, Instagram reels, and TikTok trends. His engaging style enhances storytelling, promotions, and entertainment content, keeping audiences hooked. Designed for creators looking to boost engagement and authenticity in Indian English content, Bunty delivers a smooth and dynamic performance.

voices.name: Bunny - Calm, Clear
voices.description: Calm, clear, and friendly, with a spark of energy. Like a neighbourhood friend who’s great at telling stories. Ideal for narration, storytelling, explainers, and conversational content.

voices.name: Bunny - Calm & Reassuring
voices.description: A calm, engaging, and expressive voice ideal for podcasts, documentary narration, audiobooks, and public speaking, with a soothing, meditative quality suited to yoga and spirituality content.

voices.name: Aisyah - Village Aunty Character
voices.description: Cheeky, nosy, and naturally funny — Aisyah plays the neighbourhood aunty who knows everyone's business before they do, delivering gossip with genuine comic timing. Her lively, conversational rhythm captures the classic Malay makcik archetype familiar from kampung comedy sketches. Built for comedy sketches, animation, and social media content. Ideal for Malaysian comedy productions, animation studios, and ad campaigns.
